events.title: Macintosh Plus released
events.summary: Apple released the Macintosh Plus on January 16, 1986 — the first Mac with 1 MB RAM, a SCSI port, and the extended keyboard.
events.about: The Plus was the Mac developers actually used for desktop publishing and HyperCard stacks — enough memory to run MultiFinder and SCSI hard drives. It extended the Macintosh platform through the late 1980s before the SE and II arrived.

narrative.whyChosen: The Mac Plus made the original Macintosh platform practical for daily professional work.
narrative.whyImportant: SCSI and expanded RAM turned the Mac from a demo machine into a production tool.
narrative.problemSolved: Original Macs lacked memory and storage expansion for serious applications.
